verdict.rationale: Bench automates parts of the monthly workflow: automatic transaction categorization, an AI Categorization Assistant, and 'automatic reconciliation' that separates merchant fees from connected tools. However, the month-end close itself is delivered by a human bookkeeping team, complex transactions are escalated to a person, and no API or agent interface exists for a user's own agent (llms.txt and OpenAPI probes return 404). Missing for 10: agent-driven end-to-end month reconciliation, automated exception flagging, agent-prepared close package for human review, programmatic/API access for an external agent.
